notes: Site: IKEA DE (ikea.com/de/de), sibling of IKEA UK (SR92, same global platform per prior Home-Decor pass notes/107.md). Tier 1 (curl HTTP fetch) of homepage confirmed mega-menu nav JSON present in raw HTML (no product grid data - client-rendered), same pattern as UK, so escalated to tier 2 (Playwright/Chromium). Homepage nav JSON exposes hotspotLinks with 'Bestseller' pointing to https://www.ikea.com/de/de/cat/best-sellers/ (English URL slug kept even on DE locale, matching UK's /gb/en/cat/best-sellers/ shape). Opened with Playwright: page heading (h1) 'Bestseller', on-page copy 'Neuer Schreibtisch, neuer Schrank oder neues Regal gesucht, doch du bist dir unschlussig was kaufen? Mit den IKEA Bestsellern erfahrst du schnell, wofur sich andere Kunden gerne entscheiden und welche unserer Produkte besonders haufig gekauft werden. Filtere die Bestseller nach Kategorie, um dein Wunschprodukt zu finden.' (translation: looking for new furniture but unsure what to buy? IKEA Bestsellers shows what other customers choose and buy most often; filter by category) - a genuine bestseller/popularity merchandising concept with a real product grid, sort, and filter panel (color, material, type, category, price, etc.), not editorial. Page text shows '276 Produkte' twice (page header + filter-panel header), cross-checked and consistent - qty verified reliable. The underlying sik.search.blue.cdtapps.com/de/de/search API call was captured (component PRIMARY_AREA) confirming this uses the same global search/listing platform as regular category pages, with per-facet product counts (e.g. category facet breakdown) that legitimately do not sum to 276 since products span multiple facet values - the page's own displayed total (276) is the correct qty, not a facet sum. Filter panel also showed an in-page 'Letzte Chance!' facet (3 products) and 'Angebote' facet (42 products) - these are IN-LISTING FACETS of the Bestsellers page itself (badge/offer sub-filters), not separate site-curated PLPs, so no sub-categories invented. Checked homepage nav thoroughly (all mega-menu groups incl. 'Aktionen', 'Neuheiten', product/room hubs) and footer - no other Bestseller/Topseller/Meistverkauft-labelled entry point found. Individual product tiles across the site carry a 'Bestseller' TOP_SELLER badge (e.g. on homepage carousels) but per Sec.3 rule this does not make those PDPs or carousels their own Bestsellers PLP - only the dedicated /cat/best-sellers/ listing was recorded. Did not need Claude-in-Chrome (tier 3).

rows.evidence: Rendered page text (German, Playwright render of https://www.ikea.com/de/de/cat/best-sellers/): '276 Produkte' shown twice - page header directly below h1 'Bestseller', and again as the filter-panel/sort-and-filter header ('Sortieren und Filtern' section) - both consistent.
